title: Hex's Grim Items
description: A mod that adds grim and soul related items and weapons.
body:
# Grim Items Mod

## Overview

**Grim Items** brings items and weapons with a reaper playstyle, with an emphasis on great items based on the power of Soul Shards, found deep in the Nether

Features & How to Use
### Soul Shard

Core craftable material for all Grim Items
- Obtained by mining **Soul Ore** in the Nether (not as rare, but like Ancient Debris)
### Melted Soul

- Smelted from Soul Shards
- Eat to propel you forward (fart ☠)

- Launches you in your look direction and uses **Soul Overdose**
### Basic Soul Scythe
- High Melee Damage

- **Right-click** to steal souls from nearby entities ahead of you.

### Explosive Soul Scythe
- Steals souls on hit
- Causes explosions when stealing souls - **Shift + Right-click** to fly, cause why not 
### Death’s Recall 
– **Right-click and hold** to teleport back to your spawn point
### Soul Driver 
  - **Right-click and hold** to create a soul black hole 
  - Draws nearby entities towards itself and hurts them slightly!
